season.short_description: Flu season of the estimate, written as 2024-25.
season.long_description: Season the cumulative estimate belongs to. Seasons run from July through May.

age.short_description: Age group of the estimate, using CDC's labels.
age.long_description: Age group as labelled by CDC. Estimates for children come from NIS-Flu and estimates for adults from BRFSS. County estimates are for adults 18 and older only.

race_ethnicity.short_description: Race and ethnicity group of the estimate, using CDC's labels.
race_ethnicity.long_description: Race and ethnicity group of the estimate. Asian and American Indian or Alaska Native groups are available from the 2024-25 season.

setting.long_name: Place where the flu vaccine was received
setting.short_description: Type of place where the flu vaccine was received.
setting.long_description: Type of place where vaccinated people received their flu vaccine: Medical Setting, Non-Medical Setting, Pharmacy/Store, Workplace, or School. Percentages are of vaccinated people, not of the population.

geography_name.long_name: CDC name of the non-FIPS area
geography_name.short_description: CDC's name for the HHS region or local area.
geography_name.long_description: CDC's name for the area in data_region.csv.gz and data_substate.csv.gz. The geography column in those files is not a FIPS code.

state_fips.long_name: FIPS code of the state containing the area
state_fips.short_description: FIPS code of the state that contains the local area.
state_fips.long_description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state that contains the local area.

fluvaxview_coverage.short_description: Percent of the population vaccinated against flu, cumulative from July through the month.
fluvaxview_coverage.long_description: Survey estimate of the percent of the population who received a flu vaccine since July 1, cumulative through the end of the month. These are CDC's final estimates for the season, so the May value is the end-of-season estimate. County estimates are annual and cover adults only.
fluvaxview_coverage.statement: In {location}, {value}% were vaccinated against flu as of {time}

fluvaxview_coverage_lcl.long_name: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for flu vaccination coverage
fluvaxview_coverage_lcl.short_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for flu vaccination coverage.
fluvaxview_coverage_lcl.long_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for flu vaccination coverage.

fluvaxview_coverage_ucl.long_name: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for flu vaccination coverage
fluvaxview_coverage_ucl.short_description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for flu vaccination coverage.
fluvaxview_coverage_ucl.long_description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for flu vaccination coverage.

fluvaxview_sample_size.short_description: Number of survey respondents contributing to the estimate.
fluvaxview_sample_size.long_description: Unweighted number of survey respondents contributing to the estimate. Not published for counties.

suppressed_flag.long_name: Estimate marked not reliable by CDC
suppressed_flag.short_description: 1 if CDC marked the estimate as not reliable, 0 otherwise.
suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 if CDC marked the estimate as not reliable because the sample was under 30, the relative standard error was over 0.3, or the confidence interval half-width was over 10, 0 otherwise. Suppressed values are missing.

fluvaxview_nis_flu.name: National Immunization Survey-Flu (NIS-Flu), FluVaxView Interactive
fluvaxview_nis_flu.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
fluvaxview_nis_flu.location: Influenza Vaccination Coverage for All Ages (6+ Months)
fluvaxview_nis_flu.description: FluVaxView Interactive is CDC's end-of-season summary of flu vaccination coverage in the general population. Estimates for children 6 months-17 years come from the National Immunization Survey-Flu (NIS-Flu), a national cellular telephone survey in which a parent or guardian reports whether and when the child received a flu vaccine. Coverage is reported as the cumulative percent vaccinated for each month of the season, July through May, for the nation, HHS regions, states, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and selected local areas, by age group and race and ethnicity, from the 2009-10 season onward. These are CDC's final estimates, published each fall after the season ends.
fluvaxview_nis_flu.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

fluvaxview_brfss.name: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), FluVaxView Interactive
fluvaxview_brfss.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
fluvaxview_brfss.location: Influenza Vaccination Coverage for All Ages (6+ Months)
fluvaxview_brfss.description: Estimates for adults 18 and older in FluVaxView Interactive come from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), a state-based telephone survey that interviews more than 400,000 adults each year. Respondents report whether and in which month they received a flu vaccine. CDC calculates cumulative coverage for each month of the flu season, July through May, by age group, high-risk status, and race and ethnicity, for the nation, HHS regions, states, and selected local areas from the 2009-10 season onward. CDC also publishes annual county estimates of adult flu vaccination for 2018-2022. Self-reported vaccination is subject to recall error, and county estimates rely on small samples in many counties.
fluvaxview_brfss.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.name: FluVaxView end-of-season flu vaccination coverage
_catalog.summary: CDC's final estimates of how many people received a flu vaccine each season since 2009, by age and race, for the nation, states, and counties.
